component.name: PosterProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() m.seq = 0 ' Content items carry NO fields: no title, no poster uri. Captions are off by default ' (caption1NumLines = 0), and an absent image must not be allowed to resize a cell. for each id in ["p1", "p2", "p3", "p4", "p5"] m.top.findNode(id).content = makeContent(3) end for
m.settleTimer = m.top.findNode("settleTimer") m.settleTimer.observeField("fire", "onSettled") m.settleTimer.control = "start" end sub
function makeContent(count as integer) as object root = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for i = 0 to count - 1 root.createChild("ContentNode") end for return root end function
sub onSettled() p("all", "start", "") report("P1-one-col-no-gap", "p1", "width=poster+2*marginX height=poster+2*marginY basePosterSize=[100,100]") report("P2-column-widths", "p2", "columnWidths=[200] - does it override basePosterSize=[100,100]?") report("P3-three-cols-no-array", "p3", "3 cols, no spacing arrays, itemSpacing.x=50 -> expect 2 gaps of 50") report("P4-short-array", "p4", "3 cols, columnSpacings=[10], itemSpacing.x=50 -> REPEAT gives 10+10, FALLBACK gives 10+50") report("P5-full-array", "p5", "3 cols, columnSpacings=[10,20] -> control, gaps 10+20") p("all", "done", "") m.top.probeExit = true end sub
sub report(caseId as string, nodeId as string, note as string) node = m.top.findNode(nodeId) p("P-postergrid", caseId, "rect=" + r(node.boundingRect()) + " | " + note) end sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Helpers '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function r(rect as object) as string if rect = invalid then return "<invalid>" out = "{x=" + n(rect.x) out = out + " y=" + n(rect.y) out = out + " w=" + n(rect.width) out = out + " h=" + n(rect.height) return out + "}" end function
function n(v as dynamic) as string if v = invalid then return "?" if v >= 0 then return itos(int(v + 0.5)) return itos(-int(-v + 0.5)) end function
function itos(i as integer) as string return str(i).trim() end function
sub p(phase as string, caseId as string, detail as string) m.seq = m.seq + 1 s = itos(m.seq) while s.len() < 3 s = "0" + s end while print "PROBE|" + s + "|" + phase + "|" + caseId + "|" + detail end sub
